$comment: Tools installable with https://get.otfabric.io/<tool>. Edit here, then run `make registry`.

bacnetctl.summary: BACnet/IP discovery, property read/write, COV, alarms, BBMD and a simulated device.

canbusctl.summary: CAN FD/XL, SocketCAN, ISO-TP and DBC: monitor, decode, capture, replay and simulate.

canopenctl.summary: CANopen (CiA 301/402) discovery, SDO/PDO, NMT, EMCY, EDS and device simulation.

dnp3ctl.summary: DNP3 (IEEE 1815) polling, control, discovery, file transfer and a simulated outstation.

ethernetipctl.summary: EtherNet/IP (CIP) discovery, attributes, cyclic I/O, Logix tags, EDS and adapter simulation.

iec104ctl.summary: IEC 104 SCADA and RTU testing, monitoring, commands and diagnostics.

iec61850ctl.summary: IEC 61850 MMS, GOOSE and Sampled Values: discover IEDs, browse, control, reports and SCL.

ieee20305ctl.summary: IEEE 2030.5 (SEP 2.0) DER testing: discovery, registration, certificates and validation.

knxctl.summary: KNXnet/IP discovery, tunnelling, routing, group monitoring, DPT coding and simulation.

mbcapctl.summary: Inspect, convert and validate Modbus capture files (.mbcap).

mbtracectl.summary: Analyse Modbus/TCP traffic in pcap/pcapng traces and export MBCAP.

modbus-cli.summary: Minimal Modbus TCP/RTU client for quick probing and troubleshooting.

modbusctl.summary: Modbus TCP discovery, register scanning, fingerprinting, SunSpec, recording, replay and simulation.

nsdctl.summary: Inspect and validate IEC 61850 namespace definitions (NSD, IEC 61850-7-7).

ocppctl.summary: OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1/2.1: test CSMS connections, simulate chargers and serve a test CSMS.

opcuactl.summary: OPC UA discovery, browse, read/write, subscriptions, events, history and diagnostics.

openadrctl.summary: OpenADR 3.x VEN and business-logic clients, a test VTN, events and reports.

otprobe.summary: Identify which industrial protocol an endpoint speaks.

profinetctl.summary: PROFINET IO discovery, DCP configuration, LLDP topology, GSDML, I&M and RT I/O monitoring.

s7commctl.summary: Siemens S7comm PLC discovery, identification, memory read/write, blocks and diagnostics.

sclgen.summary: Generate Go types from IEC 61850 SCL XSD schema bundles.

sclparse.summary: Detect, summarise and validate IEC 61850 SCL configuration files.

sparkplugbctl.summary: Sparkplug B 3.0 MQTT monitoring, publishing, Protobuf coding and edge/host simulation.

sunspecctl.summary: SunSpec Modbus for inverters, meters and batteries: discover, read, poll and simulate.

deferred.docsync: organisation tooling, not a protocol tool
